# Clovis Web Design

> End-to-end brand positioning, custom web design, Google Maps SEO, AI search optimization (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Siri), and lead attribution & retention for growth-minded businesses across industries. Built and operated by Adam in Clovis, California.

Clovis Web Design is an independent brand, web engineering, and search/AI marketing studio operated by Adam in Clovis, California, serving businesses in Fresno, Clovis, the Central Valley, and across the United States. Sites are hand-coded with modern web standards (Astro, React, Tailwind CSS) for sub-0.4-second mobile loading, 100/100 Google PageSpeed, Google Maps 3-Pack rankings, and AI answer engine citations. No WordPress templates, no page builders, zero monthly hostage fees, and 100% client asset ownership from day one.

## Five Lifecycle Services (Available Individually or Combined)
- [Brand Positioning & Conversion Copy](https://cloviswebdesign.com/services/): Clear brand positioning, visual direction, and customer-facing copy written from a 15-minute interview so buyers understand within three seconds what you do and why they should pick you.
- [Custom Web Design & Engineering](https://cloviswebdesign.com/services/): Hand-coded static websites opening in under 0.4s on mobile, scoring 100/100 on Google PageSpeed, built to WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, with optional full Spanish (/es/) and compliant intake routing. Over half of mobile visitors abandon pages that take 3–4 seconds to load, and live AI search crawlers time out on slow templates before reading a single word.
- [Search Engine & Google Maps SEO](https://cloviswebdesign.com/services/local-seo-fresno/): Google Business Profile optimization, dedicated high-intent service and market pages, and review velocity systems to rank in the Google Maps 3-Pack and organic search results. Captures ready-to-buy searchers at the top of Google without paying per click.
- [AI Search & Answer Optimization (GEO)](https://cloviswebdesign.com/services/local-seo-fresno/#ai-search): Four-directory entity sync across Google Business Profile, Bing Places, Apple Business Connect, and Yelp, connected JSON-LD @graph schema, fact-dense answer blocks, and /llms.txt discovery files so ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, and Apple Siri recommend the business.
- [AI & Search Lead Attribution & Retention](https://cloviswebdesign.com/#check): Custom Google Analytics 4 (GA4) channel configuration isolating referrals from ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity alongside phone call, SMS, form conversion tracking, and automated review/lead retention flows.

## Specialized Playbooks
- [Search, Google Maps & AI Marketing](https://cloviswebdesign.com/services/local-seo-fresno/): Full breakdown of how Google, ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Siri verify and recommend businesses.
- [Medical & Dental Practice Web Design](https://cloviswebdesign.com/services/medical-web-design/): Websites for clinics, physicians, and dentists that collect zero patient health information online, built to WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards.
- [Contractor & Trade Websites](https://cloviswebdesign.com/services/contractor-websites/): Built for contractors and home service companies with tap-to-call and tap-to-text on every screen and sub-second field cellular loading.

## Engagement Models
- [Custom Website Build](https://cloviswebdesign.com/packages/): Brand positioning and hand-coded custom website (<0.4s mobile load, 100/100 PageSpeed), working phone preview before you pay anything ($0 if you don't approve the preview), done-for-you copywriting from a 15-minute discovery call, tap-to-call/SMS/search tracking, 90 days of free fixes after launch, and 100% client ownership of code, domain, and hosting.
- [Search & AI Visibility Setup](https://cloviswebdesign.com/packages/): Standalone overhaul or add-on including four-directory profile sync across Google Maps, Bing Places, Apple Business Connect, and Yelp, connected LocalBusiness/Service/FAQPage JSON-LD structured data, fact-dense answer architecture, /llms.txt discovery files, and custom GA4 AI referral tracking.
- [Ongoing Search & AI Growth](https://cloviswebdesign.com/packages/): Modular month-to-month partnership including new high-intent service and market pages each month, ongoing Google Maps, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude citation and review growth, monthly lead attribution reporting, and same-day text-me website updates. Cancel anytime with one text.

- [Kidney Specialist Inc. Case Study](https://cloviswebdesign.com/case-studies/kidney-specialist-fresno/): Nephrology medical practice in Madera & Fresno, CA. Zero patient data collected online, 100/100 Google PageSpeed, and doctor referrals up 40% by Dr. Sheikh Mohammad Masood's count.
